scope: Corollary 1.3 of the manuscript “Taming implies compatibility on four-manifolds” (preprints/Taming-implies-compatibility-on-four-manifolds-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 342 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 cbddc627efab3dd4), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under the same hypotheses, write h− J = dim H− J and let b+ 2 (X) be the positive index of the intersection form. If h− J = b+ 2 (X) − 1, then Kt J = Kc J + H− J . In particular, if b+ 2 (X) = 1, then Kt J = Kc J: every taming class has a smooth compatible symplectic representative.
